# PhysxVehicleTankControllerAPI

Thrust inputs that divert engine torque to the tracks of a wheeled tank vehicle. When the vehicle [prim](glossary.md#prim) lists PhysxVehicleControllerAPI, the runtime checks whether it also lists this API and then reads the controller columns plus thrust0 and thrust1 once, when the vehicle is created.

- **Applies to:** [`Xformable`](glossary.md#xformable)
- **Requires on the same prim:** [`PhysxVehicleAPI`](PhysxVehicleAPI.md), [`PhysxVehicleControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleControllerAPI.md)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Columns

*Raw fallback* is the [USD](glossary.md#usd) schema value. *Producer writes* is what [ovstage](glossary.md#ovstage) population puts in the column for a USD stage. *Parser default* applies on the consumer when the column is absent, in stage units. **diverges** means writing the raw fallback literally parses differently from omitting the column (the parser default): USD population may well publish that very value for an unauthored attribute, so the marker is about the column being present, not about its value.

| Column | Type | Units | Raw fallback | Producer writes | Parser default | If absent |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `physxVehicleTankController:thrust0` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: no thrust on the tracks assigned to thrust control 0. A present value outside [-1, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |
| `physxVehicleTankController:thrust1` | float32 | none | 0.0 | resolved USD value (authored, else raw fallback) | 0.0 | 0: no thrust on the tracks assigned to thrust control 1. A present value outside [-1, 1] logs an error and the vehicle is not created. |

## Interactions

- **[`PhysxVehicleControllerAPI`](PhysxVehicleControllerAPI.md):** Read only when PhysxVehicleControllerAPI is in usd-schemas as well (the schema makes it a built-in of this API, so a hand-populated row has to list both). Without this API the vehicle uses the standard controller and the thrust columns are not read.
- **[`PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI`](PhysxVehicleTankDifferentialAPI.md):** The vehicle needs a standard drive (PhysxVehicleDriveStandardAPI) and a tank differential; otherwise the runtime logs an error and the vehicle is not created.

## Notes

- Both columns are change-tracked: the runtime applies a new value while simulating; a value outside [-1, 1] then logs an error and is ignored.
